def test_free_daily_image_limit(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(quota.FREE_DAILY_LIMITS["image"]):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]

    blocked = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-over", locale="en")
    assert not blocked["ok"]
    assert blocked["error_code"] == "daily_image_limit"
    assert blocked["job_id"] is None
    assert "5 images" in blocked["message"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5
    assert get_balance(conn, user_id) == 90


def test_daily_image_limit_message_is_localized(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    blocked = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-over", locale="ru")
    assert blocked["message"] == "Вы исчерпали дневной лимит бесплатного тарифа: 5 изображений."


def test_pro_has_no_daily_image_limit(conn, lumen, pro_user_id):
    for i in range(quota.FREE_DAILY_LIMITS["image"] + 3):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, pro_user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 8
    assert quota.used(conn, pro_user_id, "image") == 0


def test_daily_image_limit_resets_at_utc_midnight(conn, lumen, user_id):
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 1, 23, 59, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    for i in range(5):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"late-{i}")["ok"]
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "late-over")["ok"]

    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "early-next-day")["ok"]

        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    last = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-4")
    assert last["ok"]

    retry = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-4")
    assert retry == last
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 5
